Verified accountApril 1 at 6:30 AM · Shared with PublicCongratulations! are being shared for Lamar Odom on reaching 60 days clean.The former NBA champion has been open about his past struggles and the road to recovery, showing resilience and determination. Reflecting on his experiences, Odom shared that revisiting his past felt like “swimming in a cesspool of trauma,” highlighting how much he has had to overcome.He also acknowledged the impact his past had on others, including Khloé Kardashian, saying, “I took you through a lot… yeah, I messed up,” while continuing to take accountability and move forward.Looking ahead, Odom is focused on growth and new goals, sharing, “Before I die I promise I’m going to learn how to swim and go back to school,” showing his commitment to a better future.Many are recognizing his strength in continuing to rebuild and move forward.(Photo: Lamar Odom / Netflix)All reactions:1.3K89 comments20 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Eugenia VeigaI thought he’s been clean ?1w10View all 2 repliesMark Baker60 days is huge!!!!
